why: The authors' public repository (Bonbhel/kabena-ml) is cloned and contains the exact validation script for the target table (validation/table1_real_datasets.py) plus shared helpers (_common.py) and the core library (kabena/core/*, numpy-only). All five datasets are scikit-learn bundled (load_breast_cancer etc.), so no downloads or pretrained weights are needed, and the code is pure Python 3.10+ (pyproject requires-python >=3.10, no Python 2 files, deps only numpy>=1.22,<3 and optional scikit-learn>=1.3). Nothing is missing: the run should work as released with at most a `pip install -e .[sklearn]` and a top-level import path fix.

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: about 5-10 minutes total: ~1-2 min install (numpy/scikit-learn already standard, pip install -e .), a few seconds per fit x 5 seeds x 6 model/dataset rows, plus the clean re-run

compute.basis: Table 1's target row is a full-batch logistic regression on the 569-sample Breast Cancer set run for 5 seeds (reported <1 min/seed on CPU); the whole table suite is stated to be under one CPU-hour, so install plus the target row plus a clean re-run fits comfortably in ~12 minutes on 8 CPU cores.
